records.text: The unidentified second pipe-bomb clip investigator said the January 2021 footage showed a maroon-and-gold Washington football mask and said Brian Cole Jr.’s mother handmade his masks because he disliked surgical masks.
records.speaker: Pipe-bomb clip investigator (09:28; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: The mask itself, itself, now this is... anybody can zoom in on this like we've done. We've spent hours, you know, zooming in on every frame of this sequence of videos, but, uh, this mask is the maroon and gold of the old Washington Redskins. Now, the timing of this particular, uh, video was in January of 2021, and no longer were they the Redskins, but they had not become the Washington ... Commanders yet. They were just the Washington Football Team. But here's what's most significant about the mask, is that Brian (Brian Cole Jr.)'s mother ... handmade all of his masks for him. He didn't like wearing the surgical mask. He didn't like the way they felt. He liked the cloth feel. I don't know what material she used, but she would, she would buy, she would buy the team colors and make masks for him, family members, friends.
